Challenge C088-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
Detail: At two dairy plants we service — one near Temerin, one outside

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Emulsified oil droplets in vegetable oil wastewater form compressible gel layers that dominate hydraulic resistance, and pre-screening through a 200 µm mesh reduced total fouling resistance by 34%.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08240","field":"abstract","quote":"Emulsified oil droplets constitute the primary foulant, forming a compressible gel layer"}]},{"text":"Ultrasound-assisted cleaning at 25 kHz reduced irreversible fouling resistance by up to 62% compared to hydraulic backwashing alone in polymeric membranes treating dairy wastewater.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08238","field":"abstract","quote":"ultrasound-assisted cleaning reduced irreversible fouling resistance by up to 62% compared to hydraulic backwashing"}]},{"text":"Fouling management through advanced cleaning protocols and anti-fouling surface modification is identified as the predominant technical barrier in agro-industrial membrane separation, with research gaps in long-term pilot studies under real industrial conditions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08246","field":"abstract","quote":"fouling management as the predominant technical barrier, discusses advances in anti-fouling surface modification and enhanced cleaning protocols"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has direct expertise in membrane fouling mechanisms in food-industry wastewater [R0745], with recent publications specifically addressing fouling layer characterisation in dairy systems [SYN-PUB-08238] and practical pre-treatment and cleaning strategies [SYN-PUB-08240, SYN-PUB-08246] that align with the challenge's core problem of rapid MBR fouling and need for improved cleaning intervals."}
